name: client-service-report
title: Monthly service report
for_each: select id, name from clients order by code

sections.title: Hours delivered, last 30 days
sections.sql: select site, count(*)::int as shifts, sum(worked_hours)::numeric(8,1) as hours from v_shifts where client_id = $1 and status = 'completed' and starts_at >= current_date - 30 group by site order by site

sections.title: Patrol completion
sections.sql: select p.site, p.checkpoint, sum(p.expected)::int as due, sum(p.scanned)::int as done, round(100.0 * sum(least(p.scanned, p.expected)) / nullif(sum(p.expected), 0))::int as completion_pct from v_patrols p join sites s on s.code = p.site where s.client_id = $1 and p.day >= current_date - 30 group by p.site, p.checkpoint order by p.site, p.checkpoint

sections.title: Incidents
sections.sql: select i.ref, i.site, to_char(i.occurred_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as occurred, i.kind, i.severity, i.summary, i.police_event, i.standing from v_incidents i join sites s on s.id = i.site_id where s.client_id = $1 and i.occurred_at >= current_date - 30 order by i.occurred_at

sections.title: Shifts not covered
sections.sql: select ref, site, to_char(starts_at, 'DD Mon HH24:MI') as starts, status from v_shifts where client_id = $1 and status in ('no-show', 'open') and starts_at >= current_date - 30 and starts_at < site_now order by starts_at

name: incident-report
title: Incident report
for_each: select id, ref from incidents order by ref

sections.title: What happened
sections.sql: select i.ref, s.name as site, c.name as client, to_char(i.occurred_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as occurred, i.kind, i.severity, o.name as officer, i.police_event, i.summary, i.detail from incidents i join sites s on s.id = i.site_id join clients c on c.id = s.client_id left join officers o on o.id = i.officer_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Who was told, and when
sections.sql: select to_char(client_notified_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as client_told, case when notifiable then coalesce(to_char(regulator_notified_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'NOT YET') else 'not notifiable' end as regulator_told, closed_on, outcome from incidents where id = $1

name: invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select id, ref from invoices order by ref

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.ref, c.name as client, i.period_from, i.period_to, i.raised_on, i.due_on, i.currency, i.hours, i.subtotal_cents, i.gst_cents, i.total_cents from invoices i join clients c on c.id = i.client_id where i.id = $1

sections.title: Shifts
sections.sql: select si.code as site, s.ref, to_char(s.signed_on_at, 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as signed_on, to_char(s.signed_off_at, 'HH24:MI') as signed_off, il.hours, il.rate_cents, il.amount_cents, inv.currency from invoice_lines il join invoices inv on inv.id = il.invoice_id join shifts s on s.id = il.shift_id join sites si on si.id = s.site_id where il.invoice_id = $1 order by s.starts_at

name: site-instructions
title: Site instructions
for_each: select id, code from sites where active order by code

sections.title: The site
sections.sql: select s.name, s.address, c.name as client, s.service, s.instructions from sites s join clients c on c.id = s.client_id where s.id = $1

sections.title: Checkpoints
sections.sql: select name as checkpoint, every_minutes from checkpoints where site_id = $1 and active order by name

sections.title: Officers inducted here
sections.sql: select o.name, i.inducted_on from inductions i join officers o on o.id = i.officer_id where i.site_id = $1 and o.status = 'active' order by o.name
